definitions.supplemental: Cf. Icel. niðr-stiga a descent : O. H. Ger. nidar-stiga.

quotations.english: the ascent and descent (of the angels seen by Jacob in his dream)

source_text: niþer-stige, es; m. A descent :-- Se upstige and se niþerstige the ascent and descent (of the angels seen by Jacob in his dream), R. Ben. 23, 7. Tó Olivetes muntes nyþerstige ad descensum montis Oliveti, Lk. Skt. 19, 37. [Cf. Icel. niðr-stiga a descent : O. H. Ger. nidar-stiga.]
